output.summary: Turnover rise is real: payroll-reconciled, not a PeopleCore artifact, and far larger than the in-state peer rise (33% to 38%). Causes are unresolved. Voluntary separations stepped up in March, when the all-branch Saturday change took effect, before ShiftWise went live in April. Pay is cited in both years, but market position is unknown. Manager blame rests on a stale manager field. Overtime is a downstream effect of vacancies. Do not approve the irreversible 15% raise or punish managers now. Get branch-level data with corrected manager dates, the ShiftWise pre/post comparison, and current market pay data before the Dec 10 lock. A targeted January adjustment remains available.
